Email.tone_guidance: Personal, direct, one clear message per email
formatting_rules: One primary CTA per email — never two competing actions
Subject line must not exceed 50 characters
Avoid all caps in subject lines
Personalise with first name where possible
Mobile-optimised — assume 60% of opens are on mobile
do: Use numbered or bulleted lists for product features
do_not: Use spam trigger words (free, guaranteed, winner)

example_structure.subject: [First Name], your exclusive offer is here
example_structure.preview: Specially selected for you — available today only
example_structure.body: [1-2 sentences on product/offer]. [1 sentence on why it's relevant to them].

formatting_rules: First line must be a hook — it appears before 'more'
Keep caption under 150 characters for best engagement
Use 3-5 relevant hashtags — never more than 5
Emojis allowed — use sparingly (max 3 per post)
Always include one clear CTA

Facebook.tone_guidance: Conversational, community-oriented, slightly longer than Instagram
formatting_rules: Keep posts under 250 characters for best organic reach
Use line breaks to improve readability
Include a link for retargeting
Emojis allowed but professional context only
Sponsored posts must include 'Sponsored' disclosure
do: Use video content for higher reach
Use carousel format for multiple products
do_not: Post without an image or video

example_structure.opening: Looking for [benefit]? We've got you covered.
example_structure.body: [Product] is here — [key benefit in one sentence]. [Social proof or offer].

formatting_rules: Lead with a professional insight or statistic
Avoid overly casual language
Use line breaks generously for readability
No more than 3 hashtags
Focus on business value and ROI language

example_structure.value: At Omnibrand Studio, we believe [core value statement].

formatting_rules: Headline must communicate the core benefit in under 60 characters
Use active voice throughout
Body copy should be scannable — short paragraphs, bullet points
Primary CTA must be above the fold
Avoid jargon — write for a general audience
do_not: Bury the CTA below the fold
Use stock imagery that looks generic

example_structure.headline: [Benefit] — [Short Differentiator]
example_structure.body: [1-2 sentences on product value]. [1 sentence on offer or proof].

formatting_rules: Product description must be under 80 words
Maximum 4 bullet points per product
Always include price prominently
Use high-resolution product photography
Consistent formatting across all product entries

example_structure.description: [One sentence on what it is and its primary benefit].
